title: Revised evidence data and frozen-snapshot replay code for decision-centered machine learning validation in geological CO2 storage
description: Current curated review classifications, source-version/member tables, coding rules, indicators, score dimensions, joint counts, source-site relations, and portable frozen-snapshot replay code. Main analysis: 68 evaluated-document units; strict journal sensitivity: 23. Two local replay checks matched 58 frozen scientific CSVs, not independent source recoding or cross-machine validation. Missing/unclear/inapplicable states are not zero. Data/documentation are CC BY 4.0; code is MIT. This data/code archive excludes manuscript files, peer reviews, copyrighted full texts, private approvals and credentials. Earlier directories are historical and are not the current 68/23 data.
